prompt:
Goal: Create a premium vertical 3:4 modular retro-futurist editorial collage poster about artificial consciousness, using a deep charcoal-black textured paper background with worn ink, dust speckles, halftone printing, cyan spot color, and high-contrast chrome reflections.

Canvas: Vertical 3:4 poster, dense magazine-layout composition, black-and-white plus vivid electric cyan. Use thin white panel borders, cyan typography, distressed screenprint texture, visible grain, photocopy halftone dots, and subtle misregistration.

Main subject: The same chrome female humanoid appears consistently in exactly 5 views: 1 small high-contrast full-body silhouette thumbnail at the top left, 1 narrow horizontal close-up of her visor/helmet near the upper middle-left, 1 large dominant bust portrait in the lower-left with her head tilted upward and one robotic hand raised beside her face, 1 right-column upper bust portrait in profile against a cyan wireframe grid, and 1 right-column lower three-quarter bust portrait in a futuristic city/interior environment. She has a smooth reflective metallic body, a rounded chrome helmet/visor covering the eyes, elegant feminine face, exposed mechanical neck components, polished robotic shoulders and torso, and dramatic white highlights.

Layout: At the very top, place a huge bold condensed cyan headline reading HUMANO. Directly beneath it, add a cyan subheadline reading MENTE SINTÉTICA  CORPO METÁLICO. Top-left contains the small bordered silhouette image. Top-right contains a vertical technical strip with small geometric symbols and the word FUTURO, plus thin cyan barcode-like lines.

Middle section: Below the title, create a bordered horizontal panel with a close-up cybernetic face/visor on the left and a cyan block title on the right reading VISÃO SINTÉTICA. To its right, place two stacked white editorial lines: "A MÁQUINA OBSERVA." and "O HUMANO INTERPRETA." Add a small irregular white technical texture patch near the far right. Under the horizontal panel, add a white sentence across the poster: "A FRONTEIRA ENTRE HUMANO E MÁQUINA JÁ NÃO É UMA LINHA. É UMA INTERFACE."

Lower composition: The large left portrait occupies most of the lower-left half inside a white rectangular border. Along its far left edge include one vertical marker strip containing exactly 5 cyan/white phase icons, from top to bottom: crescent, filled circle, outlined circle, filled circle, crescent. Below that strip add exactly 3 stacked cyan chevrons pointing upward. To the right of the large portrait, insert a tall narrow black panel with oversized abstract cyan techno glyphs/maze lettering. On the right side, stack exactly 2 bordered image panels: the upper profile portrait with a cyan grid and two white X marks, and the lower portrait in a futuristic environment.

Bottom text: Across the bottom-left inside a bordered black box, set a large outlined white techno type title reading CONSCIÊNCIA ARTIFICIAL. Add small decorative white barcode ticks near the bottom of the main portrait.

Visual style: Premium editorial sci-fi collage, cyberpunk retro-futurism, brutalist Swiss grid influence, 1980s technology magazine aesthetic, chrome android fashion photography, halftone comic-print texture, distressed black paper, cyan ink accents, sharp rectangular modules, high contrast, no extra characters, no watermark, no additional text beyond the specified typography.
